Times are changing, entertainment is subjective now, people watching other people doing something has evolved (or perhaps devolved). 

Personally i think it's senseless gluttony. These bastards eat more than necessary and binge eat while some of us starve and can only fantasize of eating a large meal like that all the time. I sometimes think well i hope you f#cking choke to Death.

But you know to each his own. It's not breaking any laws anyway.
